t.why: A member of Russia-led economic and security blocs. A 2025 treaty settled its border dispute with Tajikistan.
t.rel: A member of Russia-led economic and security blocs, many of whose citizens work in Russia and send money home. Its border dispute with Tajikistan was settled by a 2025 treaty.
t.know: It is known for the boz uy, the nomads' portable yurt, and the World Nomad Games.
t.etext: Gold from the Kumtor mine is the biggest export, and remittances from people working in Russia are a large part of the economy. It also re-exports Chinese goods to its neighbors.
